tickets.text: Reconcile the bookkeeping dashboard balance with the Teacup Comet Bank business checking account. Address the two client deposits marked as received in the dashboard but not yet settled in the bank account.
tickets.evidence: the bookkeeping dashboard showed a higher available business balance than the Teacup Comet Bank business checking account because two client deposits were marked as received even though they had not settled in the bank account. The agreed reconciliation work is due 2024-12-31.

tickets.title: Separate business card feed from household spending tracker
tickets.text: Separate the Teacup Comet Bank business card feed from the household spending tracker. Ensure contractor platform fees and design software charges are not recorded in personal spending categories.
tickets.evidence: For business card feed separation, the Teacup Comet Bank business card feed is importing into the household spending tracker, causing contractor platform fees and design software charges to appear in personal spending categories.
